programs.title: Arctic Blast
programs.desc: When a solar eclipse sends a colossal blast of super chilled air towards the earth, it then sets off a catastrophic chain of events that threatens to engulf the world in ice and begin a new Ice Age.

programs.title: The Fountain
programs.desc: As a modern-day scientist, Tommy is struggling with mortality, desperately searching for the medical breakthrough that will save the life of his cancer-stricken wife, Izzi.

programs.title: Mission For The Dragon
programs.desc: Two of Asia's biggest martial arts stars team up in this excellent offering from Korea. Two sons swear to avenge their father's murder. They set off in search of the last man to see him alive.

programs.title: A Clear Shot
programs.desc: A hostage situation at the Good Guys electronic store in Sacramento California goes awry when bullets start flying. Will law enforcement be able to come in and save the day or will the hostage takers win.

programs.title: Swimfan
programs.desc: It's a teen thriller kind of like 'Fatal Attraction' where a high school senior who's rising in the swimming world has a one-night hookup that leads to some bad stuff...
